verifiedData.ts variant naming under nexon-ev includes clearly mismatched names (e.g. 'Fearless + PS 1.5 Diesel AMT', 'Smart Petrol MT'); similar cross-contamination seen in punch/punch-ev variant lists. Historical price revisions were mapped to the closest matching names and any weak matches were omitted rather than forced.

Nexon EV Feb-2024 battery-cost price cut: effective date ~2024-02-13 inferred from article recency ('Last Updated: 972 days ago' on 2026-10-12), not a dated statement in the article. Verify before using in integration.
Punch facelift event dated 2026-01-13: HT Auto billed Jan 13 as the 'unveil', while NDTV/ackodrive reported the launch with bookings open that day. Treated as launch.
Punch EV facelift launch price Rs 9.69 lakh reported by siasat as 'ex-showroom Mumbai'; Delhi ex-showroom figure not confirmed.

Curvv ICE recorded as 'New nameplate' launch on 2024-09-02 even though the nameplate debuted with the Curvv EV a month earlier; it is the ICE derivative of the same nameplate. Coordinator may prefer a single nameplate record.

GST-cut magnitude discrepancies between sources: Punch reported as Rs 1.08 lakh (Zeebiz) vs up to Rs 85,000 (HT Business/onmanorama); Altroz Rs 1.11 lakh (Zeebiz) vs up to Rs 1.10 lakh (HT). New starting prices used (549000/630000) are per the Zeebiz table.
GST cut reported for 'Tigor' (Rs 80,000) refers to the ICE Tigor, not model_id 'tigor-ev'; not applied to tigor-ev.
tigor-ev: no launch and no notable dated price change found in window (2023-10-01..2026-10-31).

Excluded per rules (variant additions / special editions / minor updates, not launches): Nexon CNG launch Sep 2024, Nexon EV 45kWh variant addition Sep 2024, Curvv ICE SeriesX lineup reshuffle Sep 2026 (ICE Series X starts Rs 9.99 lakh), Curvv EV SeriesX lineup change May 2026 noted as price change not launch, Harrier EV AWD full-price announcement Jun 2025, Sierra Legend Series (Sep 18, 2026) and Sierra Dark Edition (Sep 21, 2026), Harrier/Safari petrol variant additions, Altroz/Punch facelift-linked sub-trim introductions. Nexon EV trim naming changed across the window (Creative+/Fearless MR/LR -> 30/45kWh personas); historical mappings are approximate.
Nexon/Safari/Harrier/Punch/Curvv/Altroz GST-cut 'new starting price' figures are from a single secondary table (Zeebiz); official Tata Motors price lists not separately verified.

model_notes.note: GST 2.0 reform: Tata Motors fully passed on the GST benefit on its ICE range effective 22 Sep 2026. Announced cuts: Nexon up to Rs 1.55 lakh; Harrier up to Rs 1.40 lakh; Safari up to Rs 1.45 lakh; Punch up to Rs 85,000; Altroz up to Rs 1.10 lakh; Curvv up to Rs 65,000. HT Business, Sep 2026.

Battery-as-a-Service (BaaS) extended to Nexon EV, Curvv EV, Sierra EV and Harrier EV from 29 Sep 2026 (previously Tiago EV and Punch EV only). Entry regular/BaaS prices per Autocar India Sep 2026: Nexon EV Rs 14.34L/8.99L, Curvv EV Rs 17.19L/10.99L, Sierra EV Rs 18.79L/11.99L, Harrier EV Rs 21.79L/14.49L, Punch EV Rs 9.79L/6.59L. BaaS is a financing option, not an ex-showroom price change.
